comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs install and permanently bend a cotter pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated latch release and withdrawal vs cross-hole insertion followed by opposite plastic bends of two legs.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without damage or collateral release vs cotter is seated, both legs exceed bend thresholds, and no prohibited rebending occurs.
comparison.reason: Extraction from a resilient lock is meaningfully different from insertion plus irreversible fastener deformation.
